title: Property document size limit
statement: The system shall enforce a configurable maximum size for a node's or edge's property document, defaulting to 16 MiB, and reject larger documents with a size-limit error.
rationale: Unbounded documents risk memory exhaustion and oversized Raft log entries.

acceptance_criteria.text: With default configuration, a 16 MiB property document is accepted and a 16 MiB + 1 byte document is rejected with the size-limit error.
Changing the configured limit takes effect without a cluster restart.
